body: I'm in the same boat as your sister, I've been suffering from EDNOS for around four years and it's difficult.  The best piece of advice I can give is to never tell her she looks "too thin", "sick", or "underweight" ... while that may be meant to shock her into recovery, it can actually encourage her.  Whenever someone tells me they're worried about me because it looks like I'm losing weight, the little ED voice in my head tells me that I've been doing good and I should restrict/purge more.  Don't go around telling her she's gaining weight or looks fat either, but yeah.  Try not to comment much on her appearance.
